newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia, U.S. officials prepare ground for summit.
newsitem.headline: Russia, U.S. officials prepare ground for summit.

text.p: Russian and U.S. officials have completed preparations in Helsinki for a planned summit there between presidents Boris Yeltsin and Bill Clinton on March 20 to 21, the Kremlin press service said on Thursday.
The two leaders will hold their talks at Mantyniemi, the Finnish president's residence in the suburb of Meilahti, it said.
Clinton and Yeltsin are expected to focus mainly on the thorny issue of NATO's planned eastward expansion to include former Warsaw Pact countries.

Russia is fiercely opposed to NATO expansion, which it sees as a direct threat to its own security, but the Atlantic alliance has made clear it intends to press on with plans to invite several ex-communist states to join this summer.
Last weekend Yeltsin, recently recovered from a bout of pneumonia, said he believed a compromise could be found in Helsinki. Yeltsin has a good personal rapport with Clinton.
